column32: Tender was invited for the second time through e-tender for the work of supply of customer feedback machine and hand dryer along with fixing. In which a total of 03 tenders were received, all the three tenders were found eligible.
column43: In compliance with the approval of the Municipal Commissioner, the financial tenders of the eligible bidders were opened. The financial tender of M/s Parth Enterprises, Saharanpur was received at the lowest price.
